lines.l: Rocks are wading, boards of rocks are wading
Swoop down from the sky and catch me like a bird of prey
Now my feet won't touch the ground
Now my head won't stop. You wait a lifetime to be found. Now my feet won't touch the ground.
Now my fear won't toss the ground
You wait a lifetime to be gone
Now my fear won't toss the ground
Now my feet won't touch the ground
